entities.summary: Jacob (Jacques) Presser was a Dutch historian, writer and poet who is known for his book Ashes in the Wind  on the history of the persecution of the Jews in the Netherlands during World War II. Presser made a significant contribution to Dutch historical scholarship, as well as to European historical scholarship.
